description: This PHP class manages database connections for the installer component of OrangeHRM, encapsulating connection setup, retrieval, and reset functionality using Doctrine DBAL.

classes.name: DatabaseServerConnection
classes.description: Manages a singleton database connection for the installer, providing methods to get or reset the connection.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the singleton database connection, initializing it if not already established.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the stored database connection, forcing reinitialization on next request.
